name: 寒冰坚忍触发
description: 寒冰坚忍在伤害结算前使受到的伤害减少50%。
skillCode: var defender = context.rulePiece; if (!defender || !context.piece || context.piece.instanceId !== defender.instanceId || !defender.statusTags.some(function(t) { return t.type === 'icebound-fortitude'; })) return { success: false, message: '' }; if (context.damage > 0) context.damage = Math.floor(context.damage * 0.5); return { success: true, message: defender.name + '的寒冰坚忍使伤害减少50%' };
